title: إِدْغَام كَبِير مُتَمَاثِلَيْن
titleEn: Idghām Kabīr Mutamāthilān in separate words
description: This section talks about the rules when idghām kabīr mithlān occurs in separate words (ie the mudgham is at the end of the first word and the mudgham fῑh is at the beginning of the next word. For a description of these terms see the previous section on idghām kabīr mithlān in a single word.)

shatibiyyahReference.notes: Note from al-Shaṭibīyyah Idghām kabīr only occurs for Imam Sūsī.

idghām_kabir_as_general_rule.title: Idghām kabīr when two identical letters come together in two separate words.
idghām_kabir_as_general_rule.description: As a general rule Imam Sūsī will make idghām kabīr when two identical letters come together.
exceptions: The first letter must not be the tāʾ of the first person, e.g. كُنتُ تُرَابًا
The first letter must not be the tāʾ of the second person, e.g. أَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ
The first letter must not have a tanwīn, e.g. وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
The first letter must not have a shaddah, e.g. تَمَّ مِيقَاتُ

examples.note: Here the two م will merge and be read as one emphasized م

idhar_when_ikhfa_nun.title: Iẓhār in يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُ
idhar_when_ikhfa_nun.description: While this instance meets the apparent conditions for when Imam Sūsī will make idghām, iẓhār is made here. The reason is that there is ikhfāʾ in the ن which makes it difficult to merge the following letter ك into the subsequent ك.

examples.verse: examples of no idghām kabir mithlain when ikhfa

khulf_on_muallal.title: Khulf on muaʿllal verbs/dropped final alif, wāw or yāʾ
khulf_on_muallal.description: There is a difference of opinion as to whether there will be idghām kabīr in verbs whose end letter (which is also a root letter of the word) has dropped, if the current last letter and the first letter of the next word are identical. Both ways are permissible.
khulf_on_muallal.note: Imam al-Shaṭibī clarifies that when the ي of first person is dropped as in يا قَوْمِ مَن there will be idghām kabīr without any disagreement because the yāʾ mutakallim (first person) in these examples is not part of the root letters of the word.

examples.note: The original form of the first word يَبْتَغِي ends in a ي which is dropped. This creates the meeting of the غs and both idghām kabir and iẓhār can be made here

idgham_al_luti.title: Idghām kabīr on ءَالَ لُوطٍ
idgham_al_luti.description: Imam al-Shaṭibī clarifies idghām will be made in this word

examples.verse: examples of idghām kabir ala lutin

idgham_of_huwa_wow.title: Idghām kabīr on هو when followed by و
idgham_of_huwa_wow.description: As a general rule Imam Sūsī will make idghām kabīr when هو is followed by و.
idgham_of_huwa_wow.note: when there is a wāw before هو, the riwāyah of Sūsī is to recite it with a sukūn as in وَهْوَ. In that case, there will be idghām without any difference of opinion (when it is followed by a و.). Some may wonder why does Imam Shaṭibī single out هو when the ه is maḍmūmah even though in application idghām is made for Imam Sūsī whether it is maḍmūmah or with sukūn. This is because in some scholars opined that when the ه is maḍmūmah iẓhār should be made instead. Imam Shaṭibī by singling out this case of ه maḍmūmah is stating clearly his opinion that idghām is to be made.
